result.summary: Detected two visual issues: a missing navigation icon and a truncated restaurant name.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar is missing its icon, leaving an empty space above the text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the correct icon asset is linked and renders properly in the navigation bar.

issues.description: The title 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' in the horizontal scroll list.
issues.suggestion: Adjust font size, use text wrapping, or increase container width to prevent mid-word truncation.
